755: /// Trusted fallback for version strings outside the finite modeled subset.
756: ///
757: /// The broad exec/spec equality claim was narrowed out of this trusted bridge:
758: /// admitted finite-model inputs now flow through verified executable helpers in
759: /// `compare_versions`, while this fallback only promises a normalized ordering
760: /// for out-of-model or length-overflow cases.
761: /// @verified-logic:permanent-z3-limit — full unbounded exec/spec connection remains trusted only for fallback behavior
762: #[verifier::external_body]
763: fn compare_versions_unmodeled_trusted(a: &Vec<u8>, b: &Vec<u8>) -> (result: i8)
764:     ensures result == -1 || result == 0 || result == 1
765: {
766:     let mut ai: usize = 0;
767:     let mut bi: usize = 0;
768: 
769:     loop {
770:         // Skip separators
771:         while ai < a.len() && (a[ai] == b'.' || a[ai] == b'-') { ai += 1; }
772:         while bi < b.len() && (b[bi] == b'.' || b[bi] == b'-') { bi += 1; }
773: 
774:         // Both exhausted → equal
775:         if ai >= a.len() && bi >= b.len() { return 0; }
776: 
777:         // Extract components
778:         let a_start = ai;
779:         let b_start = bi;
780:         let a_numeric = ai < a.len() && a[ai].is_ascii_digit();
781:         let b_numeric = bi < b.len() && b[bi].is_ascii_digit();
782: 
783:         if a_numeric {
784:             while ai < a.len() && a[ai].is_ascii_digit() { ai += 1; }
785:         } else {
786:             while ai < a.len() && a[ai].is_ascii_alphabetic() { ai += 1; }
787:         }
788:         if b_numeric {
789:             while bi < b.len() && b[bi].is_ascii_digit() { bi += 1; }
790:         } else {
791:             while bi < b.len() && b[bi].is_ascii_alphabetic() { bi += 1; }
792:         }
793: 
794:         let a_comp = &a[a_start..ai];
795:         let b_comp = &b[b_start..bi];
796: 
797:         // Empty component loses
798:         if a_comp.is_empty() && !b_comp.is_empty() { return -1; }
799:         if !a_comp.is_empty() && b_comp.is_empty() { return 1; }
800: 
801:         // Type mismatch: numeric > alpha
802:         if a_numeric && !b_numeric { return 1; }
803:         if !a_numeric && b_numeric { return -1; }
804: 
805:         // Same type: compare
806:         if a_numeric {
807:             // Strip leading zeros and compare numerically
808:             let a_val = parse_numeric(a_comp);
809:             let b_val = parse_numeric(b_comp);
810:             if a_val < b_val { return -1; }
811:             if a_val > b_val { return 1; }
812:         } else {
813:             // Lexicographic
814:             match a_comp.cmp(b_comp) {
815:                 std::cmp::Ordering::Less => return -1,
816:                 std::cmp::Ordering::Greater => return 1,
817:                 std::cmp::Ordering::Equal => {}
818:             }
819:         }
820:     }
821: }

612:     // r[impl properties.sequential-chunk-continuation]
613:     /// Reading consecutive chunks is detected as sequential.
614:     pub open spec fn sequential_chunk_continuation_prop(
615:         chunk_size: u64, index: u64,
616:     ) -> bool
617:         recommends
618:             chunk_size > 0,
619:             index as int * chunk_size as int <= u64::MAX as int,
620:             (index as int + 1) * chunk_size as int <= u64::MAX as int,
621:     {
622:         is_sequential_spec(
623:             chunk_offset_spec(chunk_size, (index + 1) as u64),
624:             chunk_offset_spec(chunk_size, index),
625:             chunk_size,
626:         )
627:     }
628: 
629:     // r[verify properties.sequential-chunk-continuation]
630:     proof fn prove_sequential_chunk_continuation(chunk_size: u64, index: u64)
631:         requires
632:             chunk_size > 0,
633:             index as int * chunk_size as int <= u64::MAX as int,
634:             (index as int + 1) * chunk_size as int <= u64::MAX as int,
635:         ensures sequential_chunk_continuation_prop(chunk_size, index)
636:     {
637:         let cs = chunk_size as int;
638:         let idx = index as int;
639:         let lo = idx * cs;
640:         let hi = (idx + 1) * cs;
641:         // Step 1: both products are non-negative and fit in u64
642:         assert(idx >= 0 && cs > 0) by(nonlinear_arith)
643:             requires idx >= 0, cs > 0;
644:         assert(lo >= 0) by(nonlinear_arith)
645:             requires idx >= 0, cs > 0, lo == idx * cs;
646:         assert(hi >= 0) by(nonlinear_arith)
647:             requires idx >= 0, cs > 0, hi == (idx + 1) * cs;
648:         // Step 2: as-u64 casts are lossless
649:         assert((lo as u64) as int == lo);
650:         assert((hi as u64) as int == hi);
651:         // Step 3: algebraic step — (i+1)*cs == i*cs + cs
652:         assert(hi == lo + cs) by(nonlinear_arith)
653:             requires idx >= 0, cs > 0, hi == (idx + 1) * cs, lo == idx * cs;
654:         // Step 4: the addition doesn't overflow u64
655:         assert(lo + cs <= u64::MAX as int);
656:         // Step 5: unfold chunk_offset_spec
657:         // chunk_offset_spec(cs, idx) = (idx as int * cs as int) as u64
658:         // index + 1 fits in u64 because (index+1)*cs <= MAX and cs > 0
659:         assert(idx + 1 <= u64::MAX as int) by(nonlinear_arith)
660:             requires cs > 0, (idx + 1) * cs <= u64::MAX as int;
661:         let next_idx = (index + 1) as u64;
662:         assert(next_idx as int == idx + 1);
663:         // chunk_offset_spec(chunk_size, index) = (index as int * cs) as u64 = lo as u64
664:         assert(chunk_offset_spec(chunk_size, index) as int == lo);
665:         // chunk_offset_spec(chunk_size, next_idx) = (next_idx as int * cs) as u64
666:         // = ((idx+1) * cs) as u64 = hi as u64
667:         assert(next_idx as int * cs == hi) by(nonlinear_arith)
668:             requires next_idx as int == idx + 1, hi == (idx + 1) * cs;
669:         assert((next_idx as int * cs as int) as u64 as int == hi);
670:         assert(chunk_offset_spec(chunk_size, next_idx) as int == hi);
671:         // Step 6: is_sequential_spec: lo + cs = hi <= MAX, offset == last_offset + cs
672:         let last_offset = chunk_offset_spec(chunk_size, index);
673:         let offset = chunk_offset_spec(chunk_size, next_idx);
674:         assert(last_offset as int + chunk_size as int <= u64::MAX as int);
675:         assert(offset == (last_offset + chunk_size));
676:     }
